game.name: Bloons Tower Defense 6
game.rules:
IMPORTANT:

• Player MUST show the home screen before AND after their entire run, including the player submitting a CO-OP run.

• Please do not cover the play button to ensure a mod can properly verify your run.

• PLEASE submit a **YouTube** or **Twitch** video link of your run. Links to iCloud, Google Drive, or your desktop folder can't and won't be verified.

- You may not pause the game to gain an advantage including (but not limited to) placing towers, using abilities, or upgrading towers.
- IF USING THE IN GAME TIMER MOD please see rules at the bottom of the screen.

TIMING:

• Timing begins the frame the single arrow play button turns into a double arrow button.

• Timing ends the frame the two arrows revert back to one arrow at the end of a run

BANNED ITEMS:

• NO use of instant monkeys (insta-monkeys)

•  NO powers (EXCEPT Monkey Farmer and Tech Bot)

• NO double cash mode

• NO using monkey money injections to upgrade your heroes in game

• NO using "continue" if you lose all your lives

• NO use of any glitches

• NO use of game mods (modded towers, modded upgrades,  etc)

• NO use of macros/auto-hotkeys (example: You yourself must press 'A' for wizard monkey, you can't have a program do it for you)

ALLOWED ITEMS:

• You may place down towers or send money between players before pressing the start button. In other words, you can take your time to prepare before the game/timer starts

• All Monkey Knowledge points are allowed

• Monkey Farmer power is allowed

• ONE (1) Tech Bot power is allowed

• Trophy store cosmetics are allowed

• Big/small bloons/towers are allowed

• Uncapping your FPS to allow for greater than 60 frames per second is allowed

• Using an emulator is allowed

IN GAME TIMER MOD RULES:

- Your game must be on fast forward the whole run, starting from as fast as you can on the first round. Hitting the spacebar on accident mid run is okay as long as it doesn't give you an advantage and it is immediately corrected. This will be up to the mod's discretion.
- You may not pause the game
- Autostart must be on
- You may not exit and rejoin

categories.name: Black Border% (Coop)
categories.rules:
For Timing :
Timing starts on pressing play on first difficulty played and ends on the first frame the fast forward button reverts back to one arrow (which will not be highlighted anymore.) at the end of the last difficulty played. Final Time would be calculated by adding all times for each difficulty (basically removing the time of being in the menu screen)

Rules = 
- No double cash
- No modding the game of any kind
- Must show the entire run from start to finish (No cuts in between the difficulty change)
- No Insta monkeys and power (except monkey farmer)
- No continues (If fail mid run, just restart the difficulty but keep the timer running, unless thinking of resetting)
- Monkey Knowledge permitted
- It is fine if you already black bordered the map as long as you re-beat all difficulty again without exiting the map midway in the CHIMPS mode.
- You can do the difficulty in any order as you'd like (for example, CHIMPs first, etc.)
- You can switch heroes between difficulties
- (Temporary) When submitting, for the hero, just put in the hero you used the most.
- Players must stay the same, no switching players and so on. So make sure to plan ahead (long est. time for the run = ~3h 30m)
- In between maps, you are only allowed to stay in the title screen, hero selection screen and coop (selection, waiting room, etc.) screen (to select next difficulty). If you were to go to a different screen, like powers or Monkey Knowledge screen, your timer will continue for however long you stayed there
- must show title screen, before and after the run
- please do not cover the play button to ensure a mod can properly verify your run.

games.rules:
IMPORTANT:

• Player MUST show the home screen before AND after their entire run, including the player submitting a CO-OP run.

• Please do not cover the play button to ensure a mod can properly verify your run.

• PLEASE submit a **YouTube** or **Twitch** video link of your run. Links to iCloud, Google Drive, or your desktop folder can't and won't be verified.

- You may not pause the game to gain an advantage including (but not limited to) placing towers, using abilities, or upgrading towers.
- IF USING THE IN GAME TIMER MOD please see rules at the bottom of the screen.

TIMING:

• Timing begins the frame the single arrow play button turns into a double arrow button.

• Timing ends the frame the two arrows revert back to one arrow at the end of a run

BANNED ITEMS:

• NO use of instant monkeys (insta-monkeys)

•  NO powers (EXCEPT Monkey Farmer and Tech Bot)

• NO double cash mode

• NO using monkey money injections to upgrade your heroes in game

• NO using "continue" if you lose all your lives

• NO use of any glitches

• NO use of game mods (modded towers, modded upgrades,  etc)

• NO use of macros/auto-hotkeys (example: You yourself must press 'A' for wizard monkey, you can't have a program do it for you)

ALLOWED ITEMS:

• You may place down towers or send money between players before pressing the start button. In other words, you can take your time to prepare before the game/timer starts

• All Monkey Knowledge points are allowed

• Monkey Farmer power is allowed

• ONE (1) Tech Bot power is allowed

• Trophy store cosmetics are allowed

• Big/small bloons/towers are allowed

• Uncapping your FPS to allow for greater than 60 frames per second is allowed

• Using an emulator is allowed

IN GAME TIMER MOD RULES:

- Your game must be on fast forward the whole run, starting from as fast as you can on the first round. Hitting the spacebar on accident mid run is okay as long as it doesn't give you an advantage and it is immediately corrected. This will be up to the mod's discretion.
- You may not pause the game
- Autostart must be on
- You may not exit and rejoin
